$meta.name: Nimiq UI Kit — Vue component manifest
$meta.description: Machine-readable catalog of the @nimiq/vue-components demonstrated live in the Nimiq UI Kit. Hand-generated so an LLM/agent can read the full component API surface without executing the JS-gated page.
$meta.generatedFrom: assets/js/kit.js — the GROUPS object (~lines 400-547). One entry per live demo; props come from each demo's knobs plus props revealed by its Vue template and code(state) snippet.

componentCount.note: GROUPS mounts 31 interactive demos across 5 groups. They reference 34 distinct component tags: the 31 demo tags plus PageHeader, PageBody and PageFooter, which are composed inside the single SmallPage demo (see its relatedTags). The kit's README and index.html say '34 components' — that number matches the distinct-tag count but is NOT the number of demos (31).

$meta.schemaNote: Custom, intentionally simple schema inspired by the Custom Elements Manifest (webcomponents/custom-elements-manifest) and Storybook stories.json/args shapes, but flattened for direct LLM reading. Per component: name, tag, group, description, optional flags (deprecated, note, relatedTags), props[], optional events[], optional slots[], and example. Each prop has: name; type (string|number|boolean|select|object|array); options[] (select only); default (the kit's interactive knob default, OR the concrete value the demo passes for an inferred prop); inferred:true when the prop/value was read from the component's template or code() snippet rather than an interactive knob (so its exact runtime default is not asserted); optional note. events[] and slots[] are plain-language strings. This is NOT the W3C DTCG or CEM JSON schema; it is a bespoke reading aid.

conventions.amountsUnit: Crypto amounts are integers in the smallest unit (luna for NIM; NIM uses 5 decimals, so 1 NIM = 100000 luna). Fiat amounts are decimal numbers.
conventions.binding: Examples use Vue 2 template syntax; a leading ':' marks a bound (JS-evaluated) prop, '@' marks an event listener, 'slot=' marks a named slot.

components.name: Identicon
components.description: Deterministic avatar (identicon) generated from a Nimiq address or any seed string.

props.name: address
props.note: Address or seed string the identicon is derived from.

components.name: Amount
components.description: Renders a crypto amount given in its smallest unit (luna for NIM), formatted for a currency with a maximum number of decimals.

components.name: FiatAmount
components.description: Renders a fiat amount formatted (locale-aware) for a given fiat currency.

components.name: AddressDisplay
components.description: Displays a Nimiq address in its canonical grouped, monospaced block form.

components.name: AccountRing
components.description: Circular ring of identicons summarizing several accounts/addresses at once.

components.name: Account
components.description: A single account row: identicon, label and balance.

components.name: AmountWithFee
components.description: Compound amount input pairing a send amount with a fee, validating against an available balance.

components.name: AccountList
components.description: Scrollable list of accounts, each with a derivation path, label, address and balance; a minimum-balance threshold controls selectability.

props.name: accounts
props.note: Array of { path, label, userFriendlyAddress, balance }.

components.name: AccountDetails
components.description: Full account detail panel: identicon, label, wallet label, address and balance.

components.name: AccountSelector
components.description: Selector across wallets and their accounts (accounts keyed in a JS Map), with a minimum-balance threshold.

props.name: wallets
props.note: Array of { id, label, type, keyMissing, contracts, accounts: Map<address, account> }.

components.name: LabelInput
components.description: Single-line text input for naming/labeling (e.g. an account label), with a placeholder.

components.name: AmountInput
components.description: Numeric amount input operating in a crypto's smallest unit, with a decimals count and currency.

props.name: placeholder
props.note: Interactive knob in the kit demo.

components.name: AddressInput
components.description: Text input for a Nimiq address with validation feedback.

components.name: SelectBar
components.description: Segmented selector bar of colored options; emits the selected value on change.

props.name: options
props.note: Array of { value, index, text, color } where color is a .nq-*-bg class.

components.name: SliderToggle
components.description: Animated segmented toggle; each option is provided as a named slot and 'value' selects the active one.

props.name: value
props.note: Must match one of the slot names.

slots: One named slot per option (e.g. slot="day", slot="week", slot="month").

components.name: LanguageSelector
components.description: Dropdown to pick a UI language from a list of locale codes.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Hover/focus tooltip with a trigger slot and content; repositions to stay in view.

props.name: preferredPosition
props.note: Exposed in the kit as the 'Position' knob.

slots: trigger — the element that shows the tooltip

components.name: Copyable
components.description: Wraps content so clicking it copies the given text to the clipboard.

components.name: CopyableField
components.description: Labeled, copyable field. Renders white text — intended for a dark surface.
components.note: White text; use on a dark surface.
components.example: <CopyableField label="Address" :value="address" />  <!-- white text; use on a dark surface -->

components.name: LoadingSpinner
components.description: Indeterminate loading spinner; inherits currentColor.

components.name: CircleSpinner
components.description: Circular indeterminate spinner.

components.name: CloseButton
components.description: Standard circular close (×) button.

components.name: LongPressButton
components.description: Button that confirms only after being held (long-pressed) for a duration in milliseconds.

components.name: Timer
components.description: Progress/countdown timer between a start and end timestamp (ms since epoch).

components.name: PaymentInfoLine
components.description: One-line payment summary: a crypto amount and the requesting origin.

props.name: cryptoAmount
props.note: { amount, currency, decimals } — amount in smallest unit.

components.name: BottomOverlay
components.description: Dismissible overlay anchored to the bottom of its container; themeable; emits close.

components.name: SmallPage
components.description: The fixed 52.5×70.5rem Nimiq modal page shell. Composes PageHeader, PageBody and PageFooter as slotted children.
slots: default — typically a PageHeader, a PageBody and a PageFooter

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Slide carousel; 'entries' names the slots and 'selected' picks the active slide.

components.name: Wallet
components.description: Wallet summary card showing a wallet's accounts and balance.
components.note: Marked @deprecated in the kit's example snippet.

props.name: wallet
props.note: { id, label, type, accounts: [{ address }], balance, … }.

components.name: QrCode
components.description: Renders a QR code for arbitrary data at a given pixel size.

components.name: QrScanner
components.description: Live camera QR scanner; starts the camera on user action (requires localhost or HTTPS). Emits the decoded result plus error and cancel.
components.note: In the kit the scanner is mounted on click because it grabs the camera on mount.
